shadows.name: panel-ambient
shadows.purpose: Lift standalone panels from the paper ground.

motion.name: settle-in
motion.purpose: One restrained first-view reveal; content remains visible by default.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action in a task area.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#08756a; border:0; border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 7px 14px rgba(8,117,106,.2); color:#fff; font:700 16px DM Sans,Arial,sans-serif; padding:.68rem 1rem; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#07584f; box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(8,117,106,.25); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #c77814; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or secondary task action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#e8dfd0; border:0; border-radius:12px; color:#13243a; font:700 16px DM Sans,Arial,sans-serif; padding:.68rem 1rem; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#ded2c0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #c77814; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact status or metadata, not a CTA.
components.css: .ds-chip { background:#dcefe8; border-radius:999px; color:#07584f; display:inline-flex; font:800 .74rem DM Sans,Arial,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.035em; line-height:1; padding:.45rem .6rem; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A readable, warm-sheet field for authentication and work data.
components.css: .ds-input { background:#fffefa; border:1px solid #cbbda8; border-radius:10px; color:#13243a; font:16px DM Sans,Arial,sans-serif; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.65rem .75rem; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:#08756a; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(8,117,106,.12); outline:0; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #c77814; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Workspace Tab
components.description: Horizontal, scroll-safe navigation for the signed-in workspace.
components.css: .ds-tab { background:#13243a; border:0; border-radius:10px 10px 0 0; color:#fff; font:700 .9rem DM Sans,Arial,sans-serif; padding:.7rem .9rem; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #c77814; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: Skill-High feels like a well-kept shared studio: paper-toned, focused, and more intentional than a generic gig board. Deep navy gives agreements and proof the seriousness they need; teal signals the next practical action.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial headlines with an operational, highly readable UI.
Warm surfaces, sparse amber focus, and a single confident action color.
Clear panels and compact records rather than a wall of competing cards.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only ordinary primary action color; amber never competes with it.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Labels support the task; only the action and the information it changes receive visual weight.

dos: Do use navy for high-trust totals and selected navigation.
Do make the next workflow action teal and keep metadata in a teal wash.
donts: Don't use amber as a second CTA color.
Don't place headings under decorative eyebrow labels.
Don't use colored side rails, emoji-as-icons, or gradient text as substitutes for hierarchy.
